summary: Target (#1603): pure actuality of the selected actual root inside STMT-NECESSARY-CLASSICAL-GOD-ROOT (da3facd6), premise of the classical-root projection 92ab7c94. Reuse check: truth related/dossier on d8024a38 and context on the root results showed no registered composition of d8024a38 with the root's proved simplicity; d8024a38 was consumed only inside the Theta.8 first-being routes (ae809bfd, 6df393c4). New: NecessaryClassicalGodRootByComposition.derive (argument 379399d1, result ef2c087e), the act-priority-at-first sibling 69affa96 with d8024a38 in place of 61ad11f3 and c6d6379b; the other 21 premises and all parameters unchanged. The root n exists at w (ActualRoot), so ExistingInActAt (0436de86, already a premise) gives InAct n esse; for any r, InPotency n r and d8024a38 give Composite n, against IsSimple Composite n, which PerfectRootPositiveIntellectWill already derives from the uniting-cause premise ca07cae9 and EsseCauseIsActualConcreteGround. Firstness is not used for pure actuality. Sense: one Lean parameter Composite occurs in ca07cae9, d7741cdc, d8024a38 and IsSimple Composite in the conclusion, and both ca07cae9 and d8024a38 link the inclusive SIMPLE_4 definition 85f7f569, so no composition-sense bridge is needed; one free InPotency (POTENCY_2, DEF 3ea2762f) occurs in d8024a38, the eternity premise and the conclusion; dropping c6d6379b (whose definition link is POTENCY_2, 3ea2762f; POTENCY_1 survives only in its label) removes two things: the DISAMB-POTENCY link 508617ab that 69affa96 inherited from it, now restored by linking 508617ab from d8024a38, 3d99779b and this argument (repair after semantic challenge on #1607); and the same-respect non-overlap constraint on InPotency, so readings on which potency coexists with possession are no longer excluded on this route. Since one InPotency runs through d8024a38, the eternity premise, IsImmutable InPotency in the attribute-sufficiency premise and the conclusion's PureAct, adopting the passive reading for d8024a38's warrant makes PURE_ACT_1 here 'no passive potency in any respect', and the eternity and attribute-sufficiency premises must be warranted on that same reading. Controls (Lean, decide, in the Solution's Control namespace, on the replaced step only, over Bool): SimplePotentRoot (every being in act in being, the root simple and in potency to a place, non-overlap holds; d8024a38, act priority at a first being and the root's pure act all fail), NonvacuousStep (d8024a38 holds with a composite being in act in being and in potency; the simple root is pure act), CompositionWithoutPriority (d8024a38 and non-overlap hold, act priority at a first being fails: a composite first being in potency), PriorityWithoutComposition (act priority at a first being and non-overlap hold, d8024a38 fails: a simple non-first being in act in being and in potency). So neither replaced bundle implies the other in general; they converge only at a simple existent first being. Warrant comparison (analyst, provisional): every registered derivation of 61ad11f3 except the strength order from universal priority 3b2d2d46 (4bcf25b5) already consumes a composition premise, 3d99779b (15fce38f) or d8024a38 itself (ae809bfd), together with ca07cae9, e0088de9, e078f07b and either 8288ff1e or ca55ed3a+d017b6b0; 3d99779b strengthens d8024a38. Relative to those supports the new route uses a subset of their commitments at this step (d8024a38, and ca07cae9 already in the bundle): literally against ae809bfd, and against 15fce38f up to the strength order 4b6d0b59 (3d99779b strengthens d8024a38). Relative to direct acceptance of 61ad11f3 or derivation from 3b2d2d46 it is an alternative bundle: 61ad11f3 at a first being says only that a first being's potencies are realized in the same respect by itself (ActPriorityAtFirst doc), which with non-overlap is close to the restricted conclusion and has no instances outside first beings, whereas d8024a38 is a general principle about every being in act in being, with ordinary instances. Semantic burden: d8024a38's warrant depends on reading InPotency as the bearer's own real passive (receptive) potency. Read as an active power (an unexercised power to act or cause), or as mere logical possibility of being otherwise, the premise would make any agent with an unexercised power, or any being that could be otherwise, composite; on that reading it would also make composite any simple first agent with an unexercised power, which the classical account the route serves denies by distinguishing active power from passive potency (no source passage was read for this attempt; attribution deferred). The free POTENCY_2 parameter does not itself impose the passive reading; that restriction is an open interpretive obligation. Positive case for the bridge on the passive reading, analyst: what is in act in being is determinate in being; a real passive potency to r is a lack of r together with a real receptivity to r; if the bearer were nothing but its act of being, the same item would be both the determinate actuality and the undetermined receptive principle, so the receptive principle and the actuality are distinct principles of the one thing, which is composition in the inclusive SIMPLE_4 sense. The q.3 a.7 quarto argument runs only composition to act/potency and supplies no converse (composition-causal-scope.md, 2026-11-11), so this positive case is analyst, attribution deferred. Strongest standing rival: a being simple in the SIMPLE_4 sense yet with a real unrealized passive potency (the SimplePotentRoot interpretation). It rejects d8024a38, and equally rejects 61ad11f3 at the root (the control shows the same interpretation falsifies both), so it is not a rival to this route over the replaced pair: it rejects the root's pure actuality on both routes. Its further commitment, an analyst derivation not formalized (Composite is untimed and cb1cdea9 is indexed to the one world w, so 'would become composite' is not expressible in the bundle): under two analyst bridges, (i) realizing a passive potency is receiving an accident, so subject/accident composition in the inclusive SIMPLE_4 sense applies, and (ii) the bundle's w-indexed premises, including ca07cae9 and cb1cdea9, still hold of the realized state with the root an actual concretum there, a root that realized r would be composite and by ca07cae9 with cb1cdea9 would have a distinct actual concrete ground, so it would cease to be a root. Under (i) and (ii) the rival therefore holds that the root has a passive potency whose realization is incompatible with its standing as root, or it restricts the composition sense of ca07cae9 (which breaks the shared sense and so the simplicity step, not the bridge). A third option is to reject (ii), the persistence of the w-indexed premises into the realized state; it stays open pending the time-indexed test (repair after semantic challenge on #1607). No independent case that this price conflicts with an accepted floor item is recorded; the rival stays visible.
